verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says it offers "automated receipts" with an AI-powered expense assistant and automated GL coding by entity, framed as covering the flow "from card swipe to month-end close." The Expenses API also supports receipt matching and uploads. All of this is first-party marketing claims with no depth on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of how receipts are captured at the moment of the card swipe (e.g. SMS/email capture or real-time matching), detail on how AI coding works or how accurate it is, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
